mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order_log (order_id, from_status, to_status, operator_type, operator_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, IFNULL(#{remark}, ''), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, from_status, to_status, operator_type, operator_id, remark, create_time FROM t_order_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
